title: Choose the revised Product Passport composition
question: The first hand is discarded. These three use an enterprise typographic system, a restrained glossy-purple optical accent, and only shadcn/ui, Magic UI, or Aceternity UI primitives. Which composition should become the production direction?

options.label: Prism Rail
options.lineage: shadcn primitives · Magic UI Shine Border · Aceternity Spotlight New
options.thesis: A single vertical amethyst light rail turns the product and its evidence into one precision instrument.
options.viewport: The complete product-image bay fills the left half. A thin vertical purple-glass rail divides it from a wide editorial measurement field where 240 mg crosses the rail; the action group sits in one quiet top dock and the required four-column evidence ledger continues on shared baselines below.
options.risk: The light rail must remain a structural anchor and never become a decorative neon divider.

options.label: Executive Dossier
options.lineage: shadcn Button Group + Tooltip · Magic UI Number Ticker · Aceternity Spotlight New
options.thesis: One uninterrupted black-glass dossier replaces dashboard cards with the hierarchy of an institutional report.
options.viewport: A single edge-to-edge dossier surface contains a generous complete left product bay and a right-side record set like a premium annual report: wide title, oversized 240 mg, serving context, and flush facts. One inset action capsule is embedded in the upper edge; the lower four columns read as a continuous ledger, not four cards.
options.risk: The monolithic surface needs exact spacing and hairline hierarchy so it feels authored rather than empty.

options.label: Amethyst Index
options.lineage: shadcn Button + Badge + Separator · Magic UI Blur Fade · Aceternity Card Spotlight
options.thesis: A luxury editorial index makes typography the interface while one glossy violet lens marks the active measurement.
options.viewport: The product owns the full left hero bay. On the right, the name, 240 mg, serving, and observed facts are composed as a wide neo-grotesk editorial index with no enclosing cards; a single shallow purple-glass lens sits behind the active measurement and the four evidence columns form a compact typographic footer.
options.risk: The fashion-editorial voice must still scan like a trustworthy record rather than campaign art.
